lines.en: This year, I want to speak English with confidence.
My goal is to finish the course by December.
I am going to study for thirty minutes every day.
Next year, I plan to travel to another country.
If I practice daily, I will improve quickly.
She wants to start her own business one day.
We are saving money to buy a small car.
I haven't decided yet, but I'm thinking about it.
It is important to have a clear plan.
Small steps every day lead to big results.
